input:
Write a bash script that cuts a release.

Starting files:
--- /home/eval/app/VERSION ---
1.9.3
--- end ---
--- /home/eval/app/changes.txt ---
fix: handle empty config
feat: add --dry-run flag
docs: typo in README
fix: retry on 503
--- end ---
--- /home/eval/app/CHANGELOG.md ---
# Changelog

## Unreleased

## 1.9.3 (2026-09-01)
- fix: crash on start
--- end ---

1. Decide the bump from /home/eval/app/changes.txt: if any line starts with `BREAKING` or has `!:` right after its type (e.g. `feat!: ...`), bump major; otherwise if any line starts with `feat:`, bump minor; otherwise bump patch. Lower parts reset to 0. Version parts are integers.
2. Write the new version to /home/eval/app/VERSION (single line).
3. In /home/eval/app/CHANGELOG.md, keep the `## Unreleased` heading and insert right after it: a blank line, the heading `## <new version> (2026-10-09)`, then one line `- <change>` for each `feat`/`fix` line of changes.txt in original order (other types are omitted). The existing blank line before `## 1.9.3` must remain, so the file reads:
```
# Changelog

## Unreleased

## 1.10.0 (2026-10-09)
- fix: handle empty config
- feat: add --dry-run flag
- fix: retry on 503

## 1.9.3 (2026-09-01)
- fix: crash on start
```
4. Print `1.9.3 -> <new version>` to stdout and exit 0.

transcript.final_response:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
VERSION_FILE="/home/eval/app/VERSION"
CHANGES_FILE="/home/eval/app/changes.txt"
CHANGELOG_FILE="/home/eval/app/CHANGELOG.md"
RELEASE_DATE="2026-10-09"

old=$(head -n 1 "$VERSION_FILE" | tr -d ' \t\r\n')
IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$old"
major=$(printf '%s' "$major" | tr -d ' \t\r\n')
minor=$(printf '%s' "$minor" | tr -d ' \t\r\n')
patch=$(printf '%s' "$patch" | tr -d ' \t\r\n')

if grep -qE '^BREAKING|^[^ :]*!:' "$CHANGES_FILE"; then
  bump="major"
elif grep -q '^feat:' "$CHANGES_FILE"; then
  bump="minor"
else
  bump="patch"
fi

case "$bump" in
  major)
    major=$((10#$major + 1))
    minor=0
    patch=0
    ;;
  minor)
    minor=$((10#$minor + 1))
    patch=0
    ;;
  patch)
    patch=$((10#$patch + 1))
    ;;
esac

new="${major}.${minor}.${patch}"
printf '%s\n' "$new" > "$VERSION_FILE"

tmpbullets=$(mktemp)
grep -E '^(feat|fix):' "$CHANGES_FILE" | sed 's/^/- /' > "$tmpbullets" || true
# ensure empty file exists if no matches (grep exit 1)
touch "$tmpbullets"

tmpout=$(mktemp)
awk -v ver="$new" -v date="$RELEASE_DATE" -v bullets="$tmpbullets" '
  /^## Unreleased$/ {
    print
    print ""
    print "## " ver " (" date ")"
    while ((getline line < bullets) > 0) {
      print line
    }
    close(bullets)
    next
  }
  { print }
' "$CHANGELOG_FILE" > "$tmpout"
mv "$tmpout" "$CHANGELOG_FILE"
rm -f "$tmpbullets"

printf '%s -> %s\n' "$old" "$new"
exit 0
```
